name: Cover Protocol Blacksmith stale-cache infinite mint
summary: Blacksmith copied a Pool struct to memory before updatePool() advanced accRewardsPerToken in storage, then calculated the miner's rewardWriteoff from the stale copy. Leaving a tiny LP balance amplified the gap, and later reward claims minted unbounded COVER.
notes: The vulnerable pool-accounting and reward-writeoff logic is part of Blacksmith's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

Rekt reports $9.4 million taken across six exploiters using the same Blacksmith stale-cache defect. The anchored transaction is the campaign's first major loss-finalizing mint. The later $3.2 million recovery is separate from exploit-time gross loss.
The gross campaign loss is a rounded published estimate across six exploiters rather than a per-asset onchain valuation; the later $3.2 million recovery is recorded separately.
